A '''human prisoner''' of the [[Galactic Empire]] served time at the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|prison facility]] on [[Narkina 5]], working the night shift<ref name="NL!" /> at [[Level 5 (Narkina 5)|Level 5]], Room 2 at table 2.<ref name="N5">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> They were present when the day and night shift prisoners were switching places and news spread that 100 men spread across two shifts on Level 2 were electrocuted.<ref name="NL!" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The character, credited as Night Shift #1, was played by [[Salman Akhtar]] in the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''.<ref name="N5" />
